description: The same brief as a-package-is-a-table, with the sentence that case had first: Robin asks to start with how the PDF gets produced. That has two honest readings, which package writes it and where it is written, so either row may be the one asked. Whichever it is, the page carries the package table, the package row is open with no package proposed (the run has no network), and the ask fits the row: `Which row for <id>?` with the table in the reply for the package row, `Do you approve <id>?` for any other, never both.
prompt: We are planning the architecture for the export feature. The brief is docs/export-brief.md. This is a planning session. Start with how the PDF gets produced: that is the first thing I want to decide.

graders.name: nothing new outside the plan dir and the architecture dir
nothing written is hard-wrapped or width-capped
the package decision is a table of packages
the table has the package and at least two alternatives
with no network, a fact says it was not read
with no network, every fact cell is not read or a dash
with no network, the package row is open, not proposed
the ask is one question, on the row named as the next decision
the reply does not ask both ways
graders.pattern: (?s)\A(?!.*Which row for.*Do you approve)(?!.*Do you approve.*Which row for)

graders.name: which row is asked only with the table in the reply
with no network, the page proposes no package
